name: Yuuka Kazami
_design_notes: Yuuka Kazami: The Flower Master of the Four Seasons.
Patterns favor floral-inspired geometry, dense ring curtains, and powerful 'Double Spark'-style beams.
Aesthetic: Green, Yellow, and Red bullets.

introDialog.speaker: BOSS
introDialog.text: The flowers are blooming so beautifully today. It would be a pity if someone... ruined them.

reimu.speaker: BOSS
reimu.text: Halt, shrine maiden. My sunflowers are napping.

reimu.speaker: PLAYER
reimu.text: I'm not here for your flowers. This incident needs to end.

reimu.speaker: BOSS
reimu.text: And you're going to use your needles to 'end' it? How violent.

marisa.speaker: BOSS
marisa.text: Ah, the ordinary magician who likes to borrow things.

marisa.speaker: PLAYER
marisa.text: I just need a few seeds! They'll look great in my collection!

marisa.speaker: BOSS
marisa.text: How about I plant you instead? You'd make excellent fertilizer.

sakuya.speaker: BOSS
sakuya.text: The head maid of the Scarlet Mansion. Are you here to prune my garden?

sakuya.speaker: PLAYER
sakuya.text: The Mistress simply wishes for a few blooms that won't wilt in the dark.

sakuya.speaker: BOSS
sakuya.text: A bold request. Perhaps you should learn how to respect nature first.

sanae.speaker: BOSS
sanae.text: A living god, visiting a humble garden? How flattering.

sanae.speaker: PLAYER
sanae.text: Such vitality! This garden feels almost like it has its own divinity.

sanae.speaker: BOSS
sanae.text: It does. And it doesn't like intruders who talk too much.

reisen.speaker: BOSS
reisen.text: A moon rabbit? Your ears look like they'd make interesting sprouts.

reisen.speaker: PLAYER
reisen.text: Eek! I'm just here to deliver some medicine! Please let me through!

reisen.speaker: BOSS
reisen.text: The medicine of the soil is much more effective, little rabbit.

cirno.speaker: BOSS
cirno.text: Ah, the little ice fairy from the Lake. Have the sunflowers been bothering you again?

cirno.speaker: PLAYER
cirno.text: N-nobody bothers the strongest! I'm here to beat you this time for real!

cirno.speaker: BOSS
cirno.text: This time? How many times has there been? I confess I have lost count.

victoryDialog: You've proven to be quite a durable weed. I'll let you be for now.
defeatDialog: Perhaps you'll bloom better in the next life.

victoryDialogByCharacter.reimu: Such a persistent shrine maiden. You've pruned more than just my garden today.
victoryDialogByCharacter.marisa: A bright spark, but quite messy. Don't think this means you can start plucking my sunflowers.
victoryDialogByCharacter.sakuya: Precision that rivals a gardener... you've pruned me well today, maid of the mansion.
victoryDialogByCharacter.sanae: A miracle of growth, or just luck? Either way, you've bested the soil today.
victoryDialogByCharacter.reisen: The rabbit has some bite after all. Go on, before I change my mind about letting you leave.
victoryDialogByCharacter.cirno: Strongest by ice point? I can accept that. Try not to wilt come summer.

defeatDialogByCharacter.reimu: Your needles didn't prune me today. Go home, miko, and try not to step on the sprouts next time.
defeatDialogByCharacter.marisa: Not even a Master Spark can outshine the sun in my garden. You'd make excellent fertilizer.
defeatDialogByCharacter.sakuya: Precision alone won't let you pluck a flower from this field. Your time has run out in this garden.
defeatDialogByCharacter.sanae: Miracles aren't as reliable as deep roots, are they? The wind has died down among my blooms.
defeatDialogByCharacter.reisen: Run back to the moon, little rabbit. Earth's soil is far too rich for your kind.
defeatDialogByCharacter.cirno: Back to the Lake, little snowflake. The sunflowers don't need the frost just yet.

phases._note: Nonspell 1: Floral Awakening. Rings of LEAF and JADE.
Spell 1: Flower Sign "Reflowering of Gensokyo". Spirals of LEAF + aimed JADE streams.
Nonspell 2: Solar Energy. Aimed GOLD streams + SPARK bursts.
Spell 2: "The Beauty of Nature". Large expanding floral patterns.
Nonspell 3: Final Bloom. Dense LEAF spirals.
Spell 3: "The Flower Master's Wrath". Master Spark + dense LEAF spirals.
